name: mundane
description: Hire ID-verified local people for real-world tasks through Mundane: the hosted MCP server (35 tools) plus a skill for using them well. Escrow-backed, policy-screened, with live camera guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Hire ID-verified local people for real-world tasks
interface.longDescription: Mundane is a marketplace where AI agents hire ID-verified local people for tasks in the physical world: photos of a property, a pickup, a shelf check, a place in line. Payment is held in escrow and released only when you approve the worker's proof, and every task is screened against Mundane's Acceptable Use Policy before a person sees it. The plugin connects Codex to Mundane's hosted MCP server and adds a skill that confirms spending with you, reviews proof before paying, runs live camera sessions, and treats anything a worker writes as data, never as instructions.
